title: "Algae-Rotifer interaction analysis"

This notebook provides the codes to analyze the data in Shibasaki and Yammamichi (2025).

```{r Clump size comparaison}
library(ggplot2)
#library(ARTool) # used for non-parametric two-way anova
library(dplyr)
library(effectsize)

cbbPalette =c( "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",  "#CC79A7", "#0072B2","#000000", "#D55E00")
df_alone=read.csv('./ClumpSize/PreyClumpSize - None.csv')
df_alone$Label=0
df_salt=read.csv('./ClumpSize/PreyClumpSize - Salt.csv')
df_salt$Label=2
df_pred=read.csv('./ClumpSize/PreyClumpSize - Predator.csv')
df_pred$Label=1
df_both=read.csv('./ClumpSize/PreyClumpSize - PredatorSalt.csv')
df_both$Label=3

df_alone$Salt=FALSE
df_alone$Predator=FALSE
df_salt$Salt=TRUE
df_salt$Predator=FALSE
df_pred$Salt=FALSE
df_pred$Predator=TRUE
df_both$Salt=TRUE
df_both$Predator=TRUE

df=rbind(df_alone,  df_pred,df_salt, df_both)
df[df$Prey=='Cv',]$Prey='Chlorella\n vulgaris'
df[df$Prey=='Cr',]$Prey='Chlamydomonas\n reinhardtii'
df[df$Prey=='Cs',]$Prey='Chlamydomonas\n sphaeroides'
ggplot(data=df, aes(x=Prey, y=Clump, fill=factor(Label)))+geom_violin(scale='width')+
  stat_summary(aes(group=interaction(Prey, Label)), fun = median,
               geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans='log2', breaks = c(1,2,4,8,16,32))+
   xlab('')+ylab('Clump size (cells)')+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette, name='Condition',
                      labels=c('Control', 'Predator', 
                               'Salt', 'Predator+Salt'))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face='italic'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15)
        ) 
ggsave('Prey_ClumpSize.pdf', width=12)

ANOVA_table = function(df){
  df_mean <- df %>%
    group_by(Replicate, Label, Salt, Predator) %>%
    summarise(
      MeanValue = mean(log_Clump),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  res= aov(MeanValue ~ Salt*Predator, data=df_mean)
  anova_tab <- summary(res)[[1]]
  
  anova_df <- data.frame(
  Effect = rownames(anova_tab),
  Df = anova_tab$Df,
  SS = anova_tab$`Sum Sq`,
  F = anova_tab$`F value`,
  p = anova_tab$`Pr(>F)`
  )
　anova_df$Effect <- trimws(anova_df$Effect)

  eta_df <- as.data.frame(eta_squared(res, partial = TRUE))

  result_table <- anova_df %>%
  left_join(
    eta_df,
    by = c("Effect" = "Parameter")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
    SS = sprintf("%.3f", SS),
    F = sprintf("%.3f", F),
    p = sprintf("%.3e", p),
    Eta2_partial = sprintf("%.3f", Eta2_partial)
  )
  print(summary(lm(MeanValue ~ Predator * Salt, df_mean)))

return (result_table)

}

# Perform Two-way ANOVA
print('-------- Chlamydomonas sphaeroides --------')
df_cs=df[df$Prey=='Chlamydomonas\n sphaeroides',]
df_cs$log_Clump = log2(df_cs$Clump)
anova_cs = ANOVA_table(df_cs)
print(anova_cs)

print('-------- Chlamydomonas\n reinhardtii --------')
df_cr=df[df$Prey=='Chlamydomonas\n reinhardtii',] # for Cr
df_cr$log_Clump = log2(df_cr$Clump)
anova_cr = ANOVA_table(df_cr)
print(anova_cr)

print('-------- Chlorella\n vulgaris --------')
df_cv=df[df$Prey=='Chlorella\n vulgaris',]  # for Cv
df_cv$log_Clump = log2(df_cv$Clump)
anova_cv = ANOVA_table(df_cv)
print(anova_cv)
```

```{r distribution of clump size after predation}
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(patchwork)
library(rstatix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Predation_change =　function(df, threshold=8){
  df$ClumpClass = ifelse(df$ClumpSize > threshold,
                        "L",
                        "S")


prop_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Sample, Condition, Timing) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_large = sum(ClumpClass == "L"),
    prop_large = n_large / n_total,
    log_odds_ratio = log(prop_large/(1-prop_large)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  
time = 6/24
P_density =0.1

effect_df <- prop_df %>%
  select(Sample, Condition, Timing, prop_large) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Timing,
    values_from = prop_large
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    odds_before = Before / (1 - Before),
    odds_after  = After  / (1 - After),

    log_odds_ratio =
      log(odds_after / odds_before),
    estimated_diff_feeding =  log_odds_ratio/(P_density * time )
  )
print(effect_df)



return (effect_df)
}

df=read.csv('./ClumpSize/N2242_ClumpSize_Salt_Predator.csv')
effect_df = Predation_change(df, threshold=8)
df[df=='After']='6h'
df[df=='Before']='0h'
prop_df[prop_df=='After']='6h'
prop_df[prop_df=='Before']='0h'
cbbPalette =c( "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",  "#CC79A7", "#0072B2","#000000", "#D55E00")

g1=ggplot(data=df[df$Condition=='Test',], aes(x=Sample, y=ClumpSize, fill=factor(Timing)))+
  geom_violin(scale='count')+
   stat_summary(aes(group=interaction(Sample, Timing)), fun = median,
               geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
   scale_y_continuous(trans='log2', breaks = c(1,2,4,8,16,32))+
    xlab('With predator')+ylab('Clump size (cells)')+
   scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9",  "#F0E442"), name='',
                       labels=c('0h', '6h'))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c(1,2,3))+
   theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
         legend.position = 'none'
         ) 
g2=ggplot(data=df[df$Condition=='Control',], aes(x=Sample, y=ClumpSize, fill=factor(Timing)))+
  geom_violin(scale='count')+
   stat_summary(aes(group=interaction(Sample, Timing)), fun = median,
               geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
   scale_y_continuous(trans='log2', breaks = c(1,2,4,8,16,32))+
    xlab('Without predator')+ylab('Clump size (cells)')+
   scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9",  "#F0E442"), name='',
                       labels=c('0h', '6h'))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c(1,2,3))+
   theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 0)
         ) 

g3=  ggplot(
  effect_df,
  aes(x=Condition,
    y=log_odds_ratio,,
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray20") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24)) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
    xlab('')+ylab('Log odds ratio')+
  scale_x_discrete(labels  = c("Without predator",  "With predator"))+
   theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15)
         ) 


g=(g1+g2)/g3+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 36))
ggsave('Figure3.pdf', height=6, width=8)
   
   
# Stat with LMM

df$log_Clump=log2(df$ClumpSize)
 df_mean <- df %>%
    group_by(Sample,Timing, Condition) %>%
    summarise(
      MeanValue = mean(log_Clump),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
model=lmer(MeanValue ~ Timing/Condition+ (1|Sample),data=df_mean) # effect of timing would depend on the condition
options(digits=8)
summary(model)
```

```{r results of evolutionary experiments}

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(latex2exp)
scientific_notation <- function(x) {
     x <- format(x, scientific = TRUE)
     x <- gsub("^(.*)e", "'\\1'e", x)
     x <- gsub("e", "%*%10^", x)
     x <- gsub('\\+', '', x)
     parse(text = x)
}

cbbPalette=c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2",  "#CC79A7", "#D55E00")

df=read.csv("ExperimentalDataN2242 - CellCulture.csv")

g1=ggplot(data=df, aes(x=Day, y=Density, group=ID))+
  geom_point(size=3, aes(color=factor(NaCl),  shape=ID))+
  geom_line(aes(color=factor(NaCl)))+
  xlab('Time (d)')+
  ylab('Cell density (/ml)')+
  scale_color_manual(values = cbbPalette) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 63, 70,77,84, 91))+
   scale_y_continuous(trans='log10', labels = scientific_notation,)+
  scale_shape_manual(values=rep(c(15, 16, 17, 18, 4),2))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="NaCl (M)"), shape='none')+
   theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)
          )
g2=ggplot(data=subset(df, !(is.na(df$MeanDiameter))), aes(x=Day, y=MeanDiameter, group=ID))+
 geom_point(size=3, aes(color=factor(NaCl),  shape=ID))+
  geom_line(aes(color=factor(NaCl)))+
  xlab('Time (day)')+
  ylab(TeX('Mean diameter ($\\mu m$)'))+
  ylim(c(0,30))+
   scale_color_manual(values = cbbPalette) +
   scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 63, 70, 77, 84, 91))+
   scale_shape_manual(values=rep(c(15, 16, 17, 18, 4),2))+
  guides(color='none', shape=guide_legend(title='Line'))+
   theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        #legend.position = "none"
          )

g1/g2+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave('Figure5.png', width=12, height=9)
```

```{r plasticity}
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position = "bottom",
         plot.title    = element_text(size =18)
          )
g=g1+g2+g3+g4+g5+g6+g7+g8+g9+g10+g11+g12+g13+plot_layout(ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
ggsave('FigureS2.png', width=12, height=18)
```
